verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a filing agency could offer system accounts, transmitter programs, or batch-filer enrollment. The evidence shows only human web filing via bizfile, mail, and in-person drop-off. The only machine-adjacent items do not qualify: a passing reference to 'requestors of Bulk data' is read-only data distribution with no enrollment path, and web User Access is a person-level authorization control. Probes found no OpenAPI or API documentation.
